title: 刘爷爷的洗碗机
title_py: Liú yé ye de xǐ wǎn jī

lines.text: 刘爷爷过生日的时候，孙子送了他一台洗碗机，还专门请师傅来装好了。
lines.py: Liú yé ye guò shēng rì de shí hou, sūn zi sòng le tā yì tái xǐ wǎn jī, hái zhuān mén qǐng shī fu lái zhuāng hǎo le.
lines.en: For Grandpa Liu's birthday, his grandson gives him a dishwasher, and even gets someone in to install it.
